scope: Fajr Parsa website public release and customer-intake readiness

company_license_and_services.notes: Written verification of company license validity and exact service scope is required; existing meeting notes are not legal proof.

public_business_identity_and_contacts.notes: Confirm legal company name, operating address and official contact channels before website release.

country_service_conditions.notes: For every service claimed available, document destination restrictions, required documents and review validity. Inquiry-only categories must not be marked approved.

written_price_refund_terms.notes: No published fees, fixed timelines, refunds or guarantees without dated written terms.

privacy_and_consent_copy.notes: Owner-approved privacy/contact consent wording and retention procedures; avoid collecting unnecessary identity documents.

customer_intake_live_security.notes: Independent production ingress, Turnstile, RLS/RBAC, office readback, replay/quota, deletion/rollback, and S21 Back validation.

approved_qa_release_evidence.notes: Exact branch SHA, full CI and QA preview, owner visual acceptance, release change-control and rollback plan.
